product_target: Secure Multi-Device + Multi-Worker + Plugin-Based Smart Operator Platform
invariants: Canonical Workflow Runtime is the sole authority for DAG dependencies, scheduling, workflow state, workflow persistence, recovery, workflow observability and triggers.
Smart Operator is an input/status adapter and MUST NOT own a scheduler, retry loop, workflow state machine or authoritative workflow store.
Device is a first-class identity and every dispatched attempt records the resolved device identity.
An exact-device selector MUST NOT silently reroute to another device.
Unknown or interrupted outcome for a non-idempotent capability MUST NOT be automatically retried.
OS-specific concerns are isolated behind platform contracts; workflow core imports no Windows/macOS/Tailscale implementation details.
V2 user authentication, OAuth rotation/replay protection, kill switch, emergency read-only and rollback evidence may not be weakened by V3.
Local device audit evidence and global workflow correlation are both required for distributed execution acceptance.
V2 production branch/evidence remains immutable rollback baseline during V3 development.
Executable production claims require Input -> Runtime -> Execution -> Output -> Acceptance; tests alone do not close production scope.

device_descriptor.deviceId: stable logical identifier such as windows-main or macbook-main

device_selector.dynamic_selector_reroute: Only when executionPolicy explicitly permits it and audit records both original selector and resolved device.

persistence_ownership.transition_requirement: State mutation and corresponding durable event/receipt must be atomic or recoverably journaled.

scheduler_contract.ready_when: all dependsOn nodes are completed and execution policy/resource constraints permit dispatch

recovery_contract.startup: reconcile durable running/dispatching attempts with device receipts before deciding retry/resume
recovery_contract.idempotent_retry: allowed only within configured budget and policy
recovery_contract.non_idempotent_unknown: manual/new explicit submission required; automatic retry forbidden
recovery_contract.cancellation: durable cancel intent before or atomically with dispatch cancellation request

operator_v2_compatibility.submit_translation: Legacy V2 ordered steps translate to a DAG where step[0].dependsOn=[] and each later step dependsOn the immediately previous legacy step.
operator_v2_compatibility.public_job_id: V3 adapter returns the canonical workflow execution id as jobId for compatibility.
operator_v2_compatibility.retries: maxAttempts maps into node execution policy; non-idempotent capability still requires maxAttempts=1 unless a future protected contract explicitly proves safe semantics.
operator_v2_compatibility.ownership: Adapter performs validation/translation/auth context binding only; it does not execute nodes.

artifact_contract.transfer_acceptance: consumer verifies hash and size before accepting artifact

forbidden: workflow state transitions outside workflow ports
